purpose: Fix the readout convention from the jlens SOURCE rather than from the paper's prose, so the kurtosis curves measure what the official implementation actually computes.
why_source_and_not_prose: The paper describes a method; the registered artifact is a specific implementation of it. Where the two could differ, the implementation is what authority 4.2 pins.

steps_in_source_order.code: def select(layer): full = activations[layer][0]; return (full if positions is None else full[list(positions)]).float()
steps_in_source_order.note: residual at the requested positions, cast to float32
applied only when use_jacobian is True

is_a_softmax_applied.evidence: line 213 calls model.unembed(residual) and casts to float; there is no softmax anywhere in apply() or transport(), and the returned object is named lens_logits
is_a_softmax_applied.consequence: excess kurtosis is computed on RAW LOGITS, not on a probability distribution

is_the_residual_normalised_before_transp.answer: NO explicit normalisation in the lens code
is_the_residual_normalised_before_transp.evidence: transport() at line 135 is exactly residual @ J_bar.T with no scaling; select() at line 203 only casts dtype
is_the_residual_normalised_before_transp.caveat_recorded_honestly: whatever normalisation the model applies inside unembed() is the model's own, and it is applied identically to the lens path and to the logit-lens baseline, so it cannot differentiate the two curves

how_the_logit_lens_baseline_is_obtained.evidence: line 211 is guarded by `if use_jacobian:`, so with it False the residual reaches unembed untransported
how_the_logit_lens_baseline_is_obtained.why_this_matters: the descriptive logit-lens curve travels the IDENTICAL path, differing only in whether J_l is applied; nothing else varies between the two curves

what_merge_does.answer: an n_prompts-weighted mean of the per-layer Jacobians
what_merge_does.see: OD-010, which forbids using it across the A and B halves

aggregation_rule_frozen_before_computati.per_layer_statistic: excess kurtosis of the readout logit distribution over the vocabulary axis, computed per (row, position, layer)
aggregation_rule_frozen_before_computati.excess_kurtosis_definition: E[(x - mu)^4] / sigma^4 - 3, so a Gaussian scores 0
aggregation_rule_frozen_before_computati.aggregation_across_positions_and_rows: arithmetic mean over all (row, position) pairs, giving one kappa per layer
aggregation_rule_frozen_before_computati.why_mean_of_per_position_kurtosis_rather: pooling logits across positions and rows would mix distributions with different scales and locations, so the resulting kurtosis would be dominated by that between-position spread rather than by the peakedness of any individual readout
aggregation_rule_frozen_before_computati.positions_used: all positions except the first, since position 0 carries only the BOS token and its readout is degenerate

claim_ceiling: This records how a measurement is taken. It licenses no claim of any kind.
